author.name: Alex Chen
author.title: Smart Home Editor
author.bio: Alex has been testing and reviewing smart home devices for over 5 years. He's personally installed 50+ security cameras, tested every major smart speaker, and automated his entire home. When he's not geeking out over the latest Matter-compatible gadget, he's probably adjusting his smart thermostat schedule for the tenth time this week.

branding.heroTitle: Smart home advice you can actually trust
branding.heroDescription: We test and compare smart home devices so you don't waste money on the wrong one. No corporate fluff — just honest opinions from someone who's installed it all.
branding.footerDescription: Expert smart home reviews and comparisons to help you build a smarter, more connected home.
